name: adhesion G protein-coupled receptor L4

function.text: ADGRL4 is the approved symbol for adhesion G protein-coupled receptor L4. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in calcium ion binding; G protein-coupled receptor activity; cell surface receptor signaling pathway.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Lung adenocarcinoma; Lung squamous cell carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.
